nativeBaseline.reference: manually navigated named region/group with visible slides and native buttons

library: Keep navigation bounded, expose only the active slide, reconcile dynamic slides and preserve control focus.
consumer: Author carousel, slide and control names; own slide content and any rotation policy.

notes: The root owns one ordered collection across its viewports. Direct React/Vue viewport and slide composition (including fragments) derives order; opaque wrappers use explicit root slideCount and zero-based slide positions. Angular/Elements derive owned descendants.
Exactly one valid active slide is exposed for non-empty collections; controlled requests do not commit rejected state. Boundary controls remain focusable via aria-disabled.
Audit mapping is provisional; dynamic collection, visual, cross-browser and manual AT evidence remain required.
